    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

<span class="part-year">2026</span></span>
		<h2>Early Voting</h2>
		<p class="event-date small-text">September 22, 2026</p>
		<p>All Arlington voters are eligible to vote early in the November 3, 2026 General Election.</p>
	</a>
</div><div class="col-xs-12 col-m-6 col-lg-4">
	<a href="https://vote.arlingtonva.gov/Events-directory/Voter-Safety-Community-Town-Hall" class="profile-list item-1 homepage-show  " >		
		<span class="list-item-block-date" aria-hidden="true"><span class="part-date">22</span>
<span class="part-month">Sep</span>
<span class="part-year">2026</span></span>
		<h2>Voter Safety Community Town Hall</h2>
		<p class="event-date small-text">September 22, 2026</p>
		<p>Join us at this free community event in partnership with the Commonwealth's Attorney's Office which will provide information on voter rights, election safety, voter registration, absentee voting, and other available community resources.</p>
	</a>
</div><div class="col-xs-12 col-m-6 col-lg-4">
	<a href="https://vote.arlingtonva.gov/Events-directory/Last-Day-to-Request-a-Mail-Ballot" class="profile-list item-2 homepage-show  " >		
		<span class="list-item-block-date" aria-hidden="true"><span class="part-date">23</span>
<span class="part-month">Oct</span>
<span class="part-year">2026</span></span>
		<h2>Last Day to Request a Mail Ballot</h2>
		<p class="event-date small-text">October 23, 2026</p>
		<p>The deadline to request a mail ballot for the November 3, 2026 General Election is at 5pm.</p>
	</a>
</div><div class="col-xs-12 col-m-6 col-lg-4">
	<a href="https://vote.arlingtonva.gov/Events-directory/Last-Day-to-Register" class="profile-list item-3 homepage-show  " >

<span class="part-month">Oct</span>
<span class="part-year">2026</span></span>
		<h2>Last Day to Register</h2>
		<p class="event-date small-text">October 23, 2026</p>
		<p>Last day to register to vote or update an existing registration for the November 3, 2026 General Election.</p>
	</a>
</div><div class="col-xs-12 col-m-6 col-lg-4">
	<a href="https://vote.arlingtonva.gov/Events-directory/Election-Day" class="profile-list item-4 homepage-show  " >		
		<span class="list-item-block-date" aria-hidden="true"><span class="part-date">03</span>
<span class="part-month">Nov</span>
<span class="part-year">2026</span></span>
		<h2>Election Day</h2>
		<p class="event-date small-text">November 03, 2026</p>
		<p>Polling places are open 6am-7pm. You must vote at your assigned polling place on Election Day!</p>
	</a>
